title: Postgres → CDC → Kafka → Lakehouse
description: Capture changes from Postgres with Debezium, stream through Kafka, and merge into a lakehouse table with correct ordering, deletes and replay safety.
implementation: Debezium with `decimal.handling.mode=string` to avoid precision loss.
Read the stream, keep the latest event per key by (lsn, ts_ms).
MERGE on the primary key; `op='d'` → soft delete with `_deleted_at`.
Checkpoint to object storage so a restart resumes correctly.
repo_structure:
postgres-cdc-kafka-lakehouse/
  docker-compose.yml        # postgres, kafka, connect, minio, spark
  connect/orders-connector.json
  stream/merge_to_lake.py
  ddl/target_table.sql
  tests/test_merge.py
architecture:
Postgres (WAL) ─▶ Debezium ─▶ Kafka (orders.cdc) ─▶ Spark SS [dedupe by LSN]
                                                          │
                                                          ▼
                                                MERGE into Delta/Iceberg
